articles.title: Athletics honor Odom, Henderson, Alderson, Ellis in team Hall of Fame ceremony
articles.description: The Athletics honored John "Blue Moon" Odom, Dave Henderson, Sandy Alderson, Mark Ellis in a Hall of Fame ceremony on Saturday at Sutter Health Park.

articles.title: Mark Kotsay credits Athletics' ‘whole team' for walk-off win over Mariners
articles.description: Athletics manager Mark Kotsay speaks with the media after his team's 6-5 walk-off win over the Seattle Mariners on Friday at Sutter Health Park.

articles.title: Athletics prospect Leo De Vries reportedly will have surgery, miss eight months
articles.description: Leo De Vries, the Athletics' top prospect, reportedly will undergo shoulder surgery and be out for potentially up to eight months.

articles.title: A's continue to play spoiler thanks to Donovan Walton's two-run walk-off homer
articles.description: Donovan Walton hit a two-run walk-off home run in the 10th inning to give the A's a 6-5 win over the Mariners as the team continues to plays spoiler.

articles.title: Athletics' first four-homer inning since 2002 fuels close road win over Mariners
articles.description: The Athletics mashed four home runs in the span of six batters during a 7-6 win over the Seattle Mariners on Friday at T-Mobile Park.

articles.title: Tony Vitello, César Perdomo, Drew Cavanaugh recap Giants' loss to Padres
articles.description: Tony Vitello, Drew Cavanaugh and César Perdomo speak with media after the San Francisco Giants' loss to the San Diego Padres on Saturday at Oracle Park.

articles.title: Athletics' Donovan Walton clobbers monster two-run walk-off homer vs. Mariners
articles.description: Athletics infielder Donovan Walton sent fans home happy with a two-run walk-off homer in the 10th inning against the Seattle Mariners on Friday.

articles.title: Former Giants, Athletics players recount experiences, memories from 9/11
articles.description: Former Bay Area athletes discuss their memories and experiences of 9/11, as well as MLB's response, in a piece that originally aired September 2011.

articles.title: Donovan Walton explains mindset during walk-off homer in A's win over Mariners
articles.description: Athletics infielder Donovan Walton joins "A's Cast" after his walk-off two-run homer against the Seattle Mariners on Friday at Sutter Health Park.

articles.title: Athletics' Mark Kotsay, Brady Basso discuss ‘outstanding' win over Blue Jays
articles.description: Athletics manager Mark Kotsay and his players speak with the media after a 2-0 win over the Toronto Blue Jays on Wednesday at Sutter Health Park.
